items.passage: The science club wanted to grow vegetables behind the gym, but the soil there was hard and dry. Instead of giving up, the members collected fallen leaves and kitchen scraps for two months. They mixed this material into the ground before planting. ⓐThis preparation took longer than the planting itself, yet the first lettuce appeared within weeks.
items.stem: Which title best fits the passage?
options: Collecting Leaves for an Art Project
items.explanation: The passage is about improving the soil before planting.
